detectors.title: Detectors
detectors.hint: Every item is validated (check digits, Luhn…): a random number is not reported. Combined with the words searched.

hints.iban: IBAN from any country, mod-97 key checked
hints.bic: BIC code with a digit, or after “BIC” / “SWIFT”
hints.rib: French bank details, RIB key checked
hints.card: Visa, Mastercard, Amex…: 13 to 19 digits, Luhn check
hints.phone: International (+33, 00212…), French or Maghreb national, Spanish
hints.amount: A number with a currency: €, $, £, EUR, MAD, DZD, DH, درهم…
hints.vat: EU VAT number (FR with its key checked, ES, DE, BE, IT, NL, LU, PT)
hints.siren: After the word SIREN or SIRET, Luhn check
hints.nir: French social security number, key checked
hints.dni: Spanish DNI or NIE, check letter verified
hints.mrz: Machine-readable zone of a passport or an ID card, check digits verified

detectors.masked: Account, card and identity numbers are masked in this report (only the last 4 characters remain).
